issues.description: Generic external specifications for core allocation types are placed inside the heap implementation module instead of the shared vstd_extra external-spec layer.
issues.rationale: ExLayout, ExAllocError, Layout::size/align, and the abort specification model generic core/Rust boundaries rather than heap-specific state. Keeping them in ostd/src/mm/heap makes the shared contracts local to one consumer and mixes external-library modeling with implementation code. Human review 3378453674 requested moving these declarations to vstd_extra/external under a CHANGES_REQUESTED review; the accepted next commit cb2be5a80af1 creates verified_libs/vstd_extra/src/external/alloc_types.rs and imports the shared models. The current centralize-trusted-boundaries rule places these external contracts in the shared external-spec layer.
